types.label: Nothing is building
types.description: No build is running while the Queue has work (with the reason: no free account, no Fable account, a split still to come), or the Queue is empty and builds wait in Pending for you. Pushed to the phone once per idle spell; cleared when a build runs.

types.label: Dispatcher self-check
types.description: The dispatcher checked every Claude account one by one (signed in, limited, API key saved and not rejected, free slots) and either fixed something (released a slot held by an ended session, cleared an expired limit, put a build that never ran back in the Queue) or found an account it can't use, with what to do.

types.label: Build started
types.description: The dispatcher started a headless session for a Queue build: which account, which model, which phase.

types.label: Build ended, returned or failed
types.description: A dispatcher session ended: every step done (built), crashed and back in the Queue, stopped early and back in Pending for you, or failed after too many runs.

types.label: Queued build failed to start
types.description: The dispatcher picked a Queue build and it did not start: the build name and the exact reason from every account it tried (a refused login, no slot, the dispatch gate, a launcher error). Sent at once, for every failed start.

types.label: Build stopped on a Claude login failure
types.description: A build's run stopped on an OAuth / sign-in failure: which account, which build, the exact error. The build is held in Pending and goes back to the Queue by itself, once, when the account's health check signs in again (a second alert says so).

types.label: Build split into steps
types.description: The orchestrator split a new build into steps (or had to fall back to rules and asks you to review them).

types.label: Watchdog fixed a build
types.description: FYI: the watchdog found a build marked running with no live session (killed exit 143, failed exit 1, out of memory, a usage limit, a dead login, a hung session, tmux gone) and fixed it with no one asking: the step reset, the slot released, back in the Queue or retried on another account; or slots sat idle while the Queue had work and it ticked the dispatcher. Says which build, the cause, the action and the attempt. One push per watchdog pass (or one per fix, Watchdog settings).

types.label: Watchdog gave up on a build
types.description: Alert: a build kept failing past the retry cap (Max retries, default 3) or every Claude account was tried, so the watchdog stopped retrying and put it back in Pending. The systems check shows it as a banner item with Fix (requeue).
